lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 7-8 horizontal rows of high-intensity white circular pixel clusters, with higher spatial density and smaller diameters observed posterior to the gill slits, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced clusters toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a semi-regular grid-like alignment of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridge features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low density of high-luminance blobs; approximately 4-6 faint clusters are visible, primarily located in the posterior and medial regions of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; the distal trailing edge of the pectoral fin exhibits a jagged, irregular contour suggesting tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small teleost fish (remoras) clustered around the ventral midline and posterior to the pectoral fin.
